lines.x: Sveriges Riksbank raised its policy rate by 0.25 percentage points to 2 percent, citing stronger economic activity and cost pressures from supply disruptions driving up inflation.
Sweden's inflation rate decelerated in October, coming in lower than market forecasts.
Sinch AB reported third-quarter 2026 net sales of SEK 7,085 million, representing a 5% organic increase.
Gold mining equities within the Lundin sphere emerged as weekly winners on the Stockholm stock exchange following a turbulent week of trading.
